company.name: Floworks AI
company.shortDescription: Floworks (YC) provides AI-powered sales employees that automate your entire sales workflow, from lead generation to CRM updates.
company.description:
Floworks AI builds AI agents that automate go-to-market workflows for modern revenue teams. Its products help sales and marketing teams discover in-market buyers, automate prospecting, personalize outreach, manage conversations, and execute repetitive GTM tasks using AI. Rather than relying on static databases and manual workflows, Floworks leverages live web intelligence and autonomous AI agents to help businesses identify opportunities and scale pipeline generation more efficiently.

Its flagship product, Agent Jesse, is the first internet-wide search engine built for sales and marketing. Instead of searching stale prospect databases, Jesse searches the live web in real time to find companies and people actively showing buying signals. Users can describe their ideal customer in plain English -for example, "Find newly opened soccer facilities in the Midwest needing turf solutions" - and Jesse returns fresh, relevant prospects sourced directly from the internet. By discovering every lead live rather than storing and reselling databases, Agent Jesse helps revenue teams reach the right buyers at the right time.
